blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) advised motorists to take alternative routes as Phase 2 of the rehabilitation works along Epifanio de los Santos Avenue (Edsa) is scheduled to start Friday evening, Oct. 16. In an advisory, the DPWH said that it will conduct its rehabilitation activities along several sections of the Edsa southbound portion from Monumento to Balintawak.
